description.en: Personal DeepSeek Harness plugins, published as-is: installed straight from their GitHub repos, updated only when the author needs it. No version guarantees.
description.zh: 个人自用的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，按现状发布：直接从各自的 GitHub 仓库安装，只在作者自己有需要时才更新，不承诺版本、不保证更新。

plugins.name: @apples1949/dsh-thinking-tag-guard
plugins.title: 思考归位 + 静默停止守卫

description.zh: 把网关漏进正文的思考脚手架归位到思考通道（thinking / summary / analysis 等任意拼写，带不带尖括号都识别），丢弃原样回放的思考，并在最后一步没有工具调用、正文只是泄漏或空答时阻止回合静默结束。另清除网关私有的 <|DSML|…> 特殊标记（含跨分片与半截 token）。按需维护，不保证更新。
description.en: Moves reasoning that a gateway leaked into the assistant text channel back into the reasoning channel for every marker spelling, drops text that replays the reasoning already streamed, and keeps a tool-less step from closing the turn silently when its answer is missing or is leaked thinking; also strips gateway-private <|DSML|…> special tokens from both channels, including tokens split across deltas. Maintained on demand, no update guarantee.

description.zh: 在输入框下方显示实时输出速度（tok/s）：生成中滚动更新，空闲时显示上一轮的平均速度。无定时器，完全由流式增量驱动；不改变会话内容，只读渲染。按需维护，不保证更新。
description.en: Shows a live output speed (tok/s) below the composer: scrolls while the model streams and shows the previous turn's average when idle. No timers — driven entirely by streaming deltas, read-only. Maintained on demand, no update guarantee.
